comment: 'O2-mättnad' is Swedish; 'O2-saturation' is a half-English form.
Source says 'large space'; A adds 'öppna', which is not in the source. Answer unaffected.
'mandibulära' is correct spelling; 'mandibulara' is misspelled.
'djup' and 'grav hörselnedsättning' are both used for profound hearing loss.
'bilateralt pittingödem' (singular) reads more naturally than plural 'bilaterala pittingödem'.
'NK-celler' is the standard Swedish term; 'natural killer-celler' is English-like.
'sin syster' refers to the patient's own sister; source means the daughter's sister ('dotterns syster').
Swedish INN is 'hydroxikarbamid'; 'Hydroxyurea' is the English name.
'high school' is left in English; 'gymnasiet' is correct.
Source expands 'Natural killer (NK) cell'; 'NK-cell' and the expanded B form are both acceptable.
'Den oönskade bieffekten som' vs 'bieffekt som': both acceptable Swedish.
'amputation ovan knä' is the established clinical phrase; B is acceptable but less idiomatic.
'Det kirurgiska ingreppet som' vs 'ingrepp som': both acceptable.
A changes the source: 'hon har därefter haft' makes the ileus postoperative. B 'för en långvarig ileus' follows the source.
Source has singular 'premolar'; A keeps it, B pluralizes it to 'Överkäkspremolarer'.
Dropping 'har' in a subordinate clause is normal Swedish.
'viral load' is left in English; 'virusbelastning' is Swedish.
'missed abortion' is common Swedish jargon; 'uteblivet missfall' is a Swedish rendering. Both have drawbacks.
Swedish INN spelling is 'oxikodon', not 'oxykodon'.
A leaves 'preterm premature rupture of membranes' in English; B 'prematur ruptur av membraner' is Swedish.
'subclavian steal syndrom' takes the Swedish suffix; B leaves 'syndrome' in English.
A has English 'Succinylcholine'/'Pancuronium'; B has nonexistent 'pankuron' (should be pankuronium) and inconsistent case.
'bör vara sticka ut' is ungrammatical; 'utstickande' fits the stem.
'penis' is singular common gender: 'normal penis'; A 'normala penis' is wrong.
'upplösning' and 'resolution av dubbelsträngsbrott' are both understandable.
'by the age of 18' = 'senast vid 18 års ålder'; 'före' is slightly narrower.
'attributionsmönster som' vs 'attributionsmönstret som': both acceptable.
B 'senast från för 4 år sedan' is ungrammatical.
'lutning' is Swedish; 'tilt' is an English leftover.
'syrgas' is common gender: 'uppvärmd syrgas'; 'uppvärmt' is wrong.
'den biokemiska väg som' vs 'vägen som': both acceptable.
A uses plain 'ADHD'. B keeps the source's English expansion. Both are acceptable.
'förångare' is common gender, so 'den' is correct; B 'det' is wrong.
Swedish months are lowercase: 'september'.
'left rotation and sidebending' means left for both; B 'vänsterrotation och sidoböjning' loses the side of the sidebending.
B leaves English 'and' in the text; A uses 'och'.
'den bakre delen av vulvan' reads more naturally than 'av vulva'.
Protected term is 'exspektans'; 'Expektans' is misspelled.
'den patogenetiska mekanism som' vs 'mekanismen som': both acceptable.
'bare-lymfocyt-syndrom' vs 'bare lymphocyte-syndrom': both hybrid forms, both understandable.
'enkelbörd' is the established Swedish term for a singleton birth; 'enkelbarn' is less standard.
'Den högsta effekten som' vs 'effekt som': both acceptable.
'spider naevi' and 'spindelangiomata' are both used in Swedish clinical language.
B leaves 'poison oak' in English; A 'giftig ek' is a calque but Swedish.
'cytoplasmatiska utskottet som' vs 'utskott som': both acceptable.
Correct INN is 'propranolol'; B copies the source typo 'propanolol'.
A leaves English 'to' in the ranges; B uses an en dash.
A 'HjärtauskuItation' has a typo (capital I) and narrows 'cardiac examination'; B 'Hjärtundersökning' is faithful.
'spikar' is the Swedish plural; 'spikes' is English.
'sharp rise' = 'skarp uppgång'; A 'kraftig förändring' loses the direction.
